## 2026-09-08 01:44
Root cause: WORKLOG_DIR/--dir only relocates the markdown corpus (wd.Root). The sqlite store resolves independently via WORKLOG_MIGRATION_DATA -> ~/.local/share/worklog-migration (cli/task_store.go:174), devboard YAML via DEVBOARD_DATA -> ~/.local/share/devboard (devboard/devboard.go:221). openStoreForWrite (store_common.go:110) opens the REAL store, renders it, and EditedIn (projection/projection.go:193) byte-compares against the fresh empty dir — absent file counts as a deletion, deletion counts as an edit, so every projection is reported hand-edited. Guard is a symptom AND a save: had it passed, the scratch write would have mutated the real store + real devboard. Working recipe: set all 3 env vars, seed minimal WORK.md (## Now/Next/Someday), worklog adopt --commit. Gaps: docs claim WORKLOG_DIR moves 'the data tree'; other 2 vars undocumented (one mention in store-design.md); no init verb for an empty dir (adopt requires a corpus); refused adopt still leaves a worklog.db behind. Recommend: derive store+devboard defaults from the resolved workdir (or refuse a write when WORKLOG_DIR is overridden but the store path is not), add 'worklog init' or let adopt bootstrap an empty dir, fix docs.
